title: Customer-Order Join
prompt: Combine customer and order tables and validate join cardinality.
scenario: Use the synthetic data described below to practise m, e, r, g, e, s,  , a, n, d,  , r, e, l, a, t, i, o, n, a, l,  , k, e, y, s. Do not assume the input is correct without validating it.

starter.code:
import pandas as pd

orders = pd.DataFrame({"order_id": [1, 2], "customer_id": [10, 11]})
customers = pd.DataFrame({"customer_id": [10, 11], "name": ["Ari", "Bo"]})
joined = orders.merge(customers, on="customer_id", how="left", validate="many_to_one", indicator=True)
print(joined["_merge"].value_counts().to_dict())
starter.dataset_note: Use small synthetic in-memory data; do not place private or real customer data in exercises.
